cases.title: Successful Schedule Creation
cases.description: Verify that filling out the Subject, Date, and Time fields and clicking the 'Add Schedule' button successfully creates a new schedule item appended to the schedule list in the correct format.

cases.title: Schedule Creation Validation with Empty Fields
cases.description: Verify that leaving any of the schedule form fields (Subject, Date, or Time) empty prevents the addition of a new schedule item.

cases.title: Successful Task Creation
cases.description: Verify that filling out the Task and Deadline input fields and clicking the 'Add Task' button successfully adds a new task item to the task list in the correct format.

cases.title: Task Creation Validation with Empty Fields
cases.description: Verify that leaving either the Task or Deadline field empty prevents the addition of a new task item to the task list.

cases.title: Schedule Form Reset After Addition
cases.description: Verify that the input fields for Subject, Date, and Time within the schedule form are automatically reset to empty after a schedule is successfully added.

cases.title: Task Form Reset After Addition
cases.description: Verify that the task form fields are automatically reset to empty after a task is successfully added.

analysis.analysis: e2edev_bench_09-R-1: Testable behavior includes schedule creation via 'Study Planner' page using 'Subject' (data-testid='subject'), 'Date' (data-testid='date'), and 'Time' (data-testid='time') inside 'schedule-section', and 'Add Schedule' button (data-testid='add-schedule-button'). Boundaries include empty fields vs fully populated fields. Normal path: all fields valid, new item added to 'schedule-list' in format 'Subject - YYYY-MM-DD at HH:MM'. Abnormal path: any field empty prevents addition. e2edev_bench_09-R-2: Testable behavior includes task creation using 'Task' input (data-testid='task'), 'Deadline' input (data-testid='deadline'), and 'Add Task' button (data-testid='add-task-button'). Boundaries include initial visibility and empty state on load. Normal path: both fields filled, item added to 'task-list' in format 'Task Name - Deadline: YYYY-MM-DD'. Abnormal path: either field empty prevents addition. e2edev_bench_09-R-3: Testable behavior includes resetting schedule form inputs ('subject', 'date', 'time' within 'schedule-form') after successful schedule addition via 'add-schedule-button'. Normal path: fields become empty. Ambiguity: exact event trigger for form reset is implicitly tied to successful addition. e2edev_bench_09-R-4: Testable behavior includes resetting task form fields after successful task addition. Normal path: task form fields are cleared to empty.
